Requirement: Test the whole P2P population, not a sample, on a regular cycle.
Acceptance criteria: 100% of purchase orders in scope are tested each cycle; coverage reported.

Requirement: Give auditors one shared view of how P2P really runs.
Acceptance criteria: One process map and variant view used by audit and process owners.

Requirement: Detect control deviations early, close to the transaction.
Acceptance criteria: Deviation visible within [1] refresh cycle of posting.

Requirement: Keep evidence of each test and its result without manual collection.
Acceptance criteria: Every test result has run ID, time, rule version and document links.

Requirement: Reduce false alarms so auditors spend time on real risk.
Acceptance criteria: False-positive rate tracked per test; tuned each quarter.

Requirement: Show where process change would reduce risk and effort.
Acceptance criteria: Ranked recommendation list with expected effect.

Requirement: Auditors need to trust the data behind each finding.
Acceptance criteria: Each finding drills to source documents and a reconciled load.

Requirement: Process owners need to see findings that concern their process.
Acceptance criteria: Role-filtered view in the publishing hub.

Requirement: Data protection lead needs personal data protected in analysis.
Acceptance criteria: User and vendor identifiers pseudonymised before load.

Requirement: Extract P2P tables read-only, on a schedule, with reconciliation counts.
Acceptance criteria: Run manifest shows source and loaded counts equal.

Requirement: Build an object-centric event log linking PO, item, receipt, invoice, payment and vendor.
Acceptance criteria: Objects link without duplicating events; model documented.

Requirement: Discover the process and show variants with frequency and duration.
Acceptance criteria: Variant explorer shows top variants and rework loops.

Requirement: Model the target P2P process with risks and controls.
Acceptance criteria: BPMN model approved by process owner; controls annotated.

Requirement: Check conformance between actual and target process.
Acceptance criteria: Conformance rate and non-conforming cases listed.

Requirement: Run a library of control tests (match, duplicate, SoD, split order, after-the-fact order, bank-detail change, block release, post-approval change).
Acceptance criteria: Each BRL-01 to BRL-08 implemented as a test with owner and threshold.

Requirement: Route each deviation to an owner with approval and closure.
Acceptance criteria: Task created; closure needs cause and disposition.

Requirement: Support plain-language questions about the process data.
Acceptance criteria: Assistant answers from the data; answer shows its basis.

Requirement: Suggest drivers of a deviation (vendor, user, plant, period).
Acceptance criteria: Suggestions listed; a person confirms or rejects each.

Requirement: Trigger a corrective action after approval.
Acceptance criteria: Action request created with approver and evidence link.

Requirement: Report coverage, deviations and closure to the audit committee.
Acceptance criteria: Report shows tests run, deviations, closure ageing.

Requirement: Data residency and hosting meet the organisation's rule.
Acceptance criteria: Region selected and documented; vendor report reviewed.

Requirement: Single sign-on and role-based access with least privilege.
Acceptance criteria: Four roles defined; quarterly access review.

Requirement: Refresh completes in the agreed window.
Acceptance criteria: Daily load completes within [window]; alert on failure.

Requirement: Every AI output is assistive, explainable and reviewed by a person.
Acceptance criteria: No deviation closed by AI; AI answers show basis.

Requirement: Tests and thresholds are versioned and auditable.
Acceptance criteria: Library has version, owner, change log.

Requirement: Do not depend on beta or roadmap features for the core design.
Acceptance criteria: Core path runs on generally available features only.

Requirement: Start with one process (P2P) and a small test set, then widen.
Acceptance criteria: Wave 1 live with 5 tests; wave 2 adds more.

Requirement: Run old sample audit and new full-population test side by side for one cycle.
Acceptance criteria: Findings compared; differences explained.
